title: Supply Chain Planning Internship (6 months)
description: Supply Chain Planning Internship (6 months) Drive Real Impact in Global Supply Chain Planning Curious about how planning decisions shape business performance and customer experience? This internship gives you the chance to dive deep into supply chain planning in a truly international environment. You will work side by side with experienced professionals, gaining hands-on exposure to data analysis, planning processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Your work will help improve visibility, coordination, and performance across the supply chain, supporting effective decision-making that impacts customers worldwide. If you have an analytical mindset, a structured approach, and a drive to learn, this opportunity will equip you with practical skills and insights for your future career in supply chain management. This role is offered onsite in our Resmed Amsterdam office located at Herikerbergweg 292-342, Amsterdam 1101 CT. What You’ll Do Support supply chain planning activities by helping maintain planning inputs, assumptions, and working files. Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring follow-up. Assist in preparing reports, dashboards, and summaries that provide visibility into planning performance and business priorities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support timely communication, alignment, and issue resolution. Help maintain accurate data in planning and business systems through regular checks and updates. Contribute to analysis and improvement activities that support more effective planning processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to standardise processes, reduce manual work, and improve visibility. Prepare clear presentations or decision-support materials for team discussions, reviews, and stakeholder updates. Learn and apply core supply chain planning concepts in a practical business environment. What You Bring Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s final year or Master’s programme in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Available for a 6-month non-thesis internship based in Amsterdam. Professional fluency in English Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work with data and translate findings into clear insights. Comfortable using Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to Power BI, Tableau, Oracle, SAP, or other planning/data tools is a plus. Structured, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-moving supply chain environment. Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Interest in supply chain planning, inventory management, logistics, and process improvement. What Sets You Apart Analytical Curiosity: You dive into data and uncover patterns that inform better decisions. Structured Thinking: You organize complex information to drive clarity and action. Collaborative Mindset: You value teaming up with different experts to solve problems. Growth Orientation: You seek learning opportunities and embrace new challenges. Attention to Detail: You understand that accuracy underpins effective planning. Why Join Resmed At Resmed, we pioneer health technologies that improve quality of life for millions around the globe. You will join a multinational team committed to transforming care and enabling healthier living. This internship offers real-world experience, mentorship, and an inclusive environment where your ideas can make an impact, whether it’s optimizing supply chains or supporting innovations that help people sleep, breathe, and live better. #LI-EU Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

title: Supply Chain Operations Intern
description:
Brief Overview
We are currently looking for a Supply Chain and logistics support Intern to join our team on a full-time basis. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly evolving environment, where you will play a key role in optimizing spare parts management, streamlining logistics processes, and ensuring efficient supply chain operations.  In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in spare parts coordination, inventory management, and supplier communication, allowing you to develop your expertise in logistics and international trade. You will support critical operational processes, analyze data to improve efficiency, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth and timely deliveries.  Preferably, you have experience or knowledge of spare parts logistics. The ideal start date for this role is ASAP.
Key Responsibilities
1. Assist in sourcing and ordering items from our logistics center efficiently.
2. Support technicians and customers by understanding part requirements.
3. Help prepare quotations and provide information on pricing and availability.
4. Assist in handling customer inquiries and complaints professionally.
5. Support inventory management, including stock level monitoring and database updates.
Who are we looking for?
You are an energetic, self-motivated individual who takes ownership, can work independently and think outside of the box. In addition:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, International Trade, or Logistics Management with basic knowledge of international trade and logistics (preferred)
Fluent in Chinese and English (both spoken and written). Chinese is mandatory.
Strong logical thinking and analytical abilities
Detail-oriented with excellent communication and coordination skills
Fast learner with the ability to adapt quickly
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
Hai-lights
We offer a dynamic and innovative working environment in a very committed organization, with the following perks:
Competitive allowance
Hybrid working: one WFH day a week
Commuting allowance of 23 cents per km (based on home-office distance). Our office location is Hoofddorp, the Netherlands
Work laptop
Frequent team building and company activities, such as company lunches, yearly events and more
Free drinks and snacks
The opportunity to contribute to a young, growing company, shaping its success and your career

description:
Unsere Abteilung ist weltweit für den Einkauf externer Logistikdienstleistungen wie Transport (Luftfracht, Seefracht, Landtransporte), Verpackungsmaterialien sowie Lagerhaltung für die Bosch Gruppe verantwortlich. Unser Hauptsitz in Stuttgart-Feuerbach steuert die globale Organisation und definiert Einkaufsstrategien. Wir bieten Ihnen ein internationales und innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, einen strategischen Überblick sowie eine hohe Anzahl an Schnittstellen zu internen und externen Geschäftspartner:innen. Während Ihres Praktikums unterstützen Sie bei der Entwicklung von Einkaufs- und Lieferant:innenstrategien, insbesondere im Einkauf von Logistik-Transportdienstleistungen. Wir binden Sie in internationale Ausschreibungen ein, und Sie unterstützen strategische Projekte wie globale Rahmenverträge, Einkaufsprozesse sowie Anfragen an die EU-Wettbewerbskommission zu geplanten Fusionen in der Transportbranche. Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie eigenständig Projekte rund um Einkaufsprozesse, Einkaufscontrolling und die Entwicklung von Standards. Ihre Aufgabe umfasst außerdem die Unterstützung unserer nationalen und internationalen Einkäufer:innen in Europa, Nord- und Lateinamerika, Asien und Indien. Schließlich sind Sie verantwortlich für das Projektmanagement (z. B. Vorbereitung von Management-Reviews und Lieferant:innenterminen), die Unterstützung unserer Digitalisierungsstrategie, die Entwicklung automatisierter Einkaufsprozesse sowie die Unterstützung des Einkaufsmanagements.

Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich (Technische) Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Business Development, Mathematik oder vergleichbar, mit einem spezifischen Schwerpunkt auf Einkauf, Logistik, Supply Chain Management Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erfahrung mit Power BI oder vergleichbaren IT-Lösungen ist von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie zeichnen sich dadurch aus, Aufgaben selbstständig zu strukturieren, gewissenhafte Ergebnisse zu liefern, effektiv zu kommunizieren und sich flexibel sowie resilient an neue Herausforderungen anzupassen Sprachen: sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, grundlegende Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

title: Mandatory Internship in Strategic Purchasing of Logistic Transport Services
description:
For our central department, we are looking for interested and motivated interns. Our department is responsible for purchasing external logistics services such as transport (air freight, sea freight, overland transport), packaging materials, as well as warehouses for the Bosch Group worldwide. Our headquarter in Stuttgart-Feuerbach is steering the global organization and defining the purchasing strategies. We offer you an international, innovative working environment, a strategic overview, as well as a high number of interfaces with internal and external business partners. From the first day, you will support the further development of purchasing and supplier strategies, particularly with regard to the procurement of Logistic Transport Services. You will be involved in international tenders. You will help with strategic projects, such as global framework agreements, purchasing processes and requesting the EU Competition Commission's approval for planned mergers in the transport industry. Independently, you will take over projects in the areas of purchasing processes, purchasing control and developing standards. In addition, your task will include supporting our national and international buyers in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, India. During your assignment, you will assist with project management, which includes preparing management reviews, arranging supplier appointments, etc. Last but not least, you will take part in our digitalization strategy and the development of automated purchasing processes, as well as purchasing management.

Education: studies in the field of (Technical) Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Development, Mathematics, with a specific focus on Purchasing, Logistics or comparable Experience and Knowledge: good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.); experience with Power BI or comparable IT solutions advantageous Personality and Working Practice: you are a communicative, flexible individual with a resilient approach to work; you work independently, in a structured manner and with great conscientiousness Work Routine: partially mobile working possible Languages: very good communication skills in English and basic German

Start: January 2027 Duration: 6 months (confirmation of mandatory internship required) Requirement for this internship is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, enrollment certificate, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity. Need further information about the job? title: Praktikum Beschaffungsplanung in der Logistik (Supply Chain)
description:
Du unterstützt unser Team bei Projekten zur Optimierung der Supply Chain und erhältst hierdurch einen umfassenden Einblick in die Umsetzung schlanker Logistikprozesse weltweit. Zur Sicherstellung der Produktionsbedarfe im internationalen Umfeld übernimmst Du Aufgaben in der Beschaffung von Rohstoffen Im Rahmen des Bosch-Produktionssystem verfolgst Du eigenständig Logistikkennzahlen und entwickelst diese gemeinsam mit den Kollegen aus der Planungslogistik weiter. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft bei der Verfolgung der Reichweitenanalysen von Rohstoffen. Du hast Spaß daran den Bosch Spirit zu erleben und im internationalen Umfeld weiter zu tragen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, wenn Du Teil unseres jungen und dynamischen Logistikteams wirst.

Ausbildung : Studium der Fachrichtung Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ähnliches Arbeitsweise : flexibel und eigeninitiativ, teamfähig Erfahrungen und Know-How : MS-Office sowie SAP Kenntnisse von Vorteil Begeisterung : Spaß daran, theoretisch erlerntes Wissen in der Praxis zu leben Sprachen : deutsch, englisch

Beginn: ab 01.03.2027 bzw. nach Absprache Dauer: mind. 20-26 Wochen, nur Pflichtpraktika – praktisches Studiensemester im Rahmen eines Bachelorstudiums. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung deinen Lebenslauf, Notenspiegel, eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung, die Studien- bzw. Prüfungsordnung mit Angabe zur Dauer des Pflichtpraktikums sowie ggf. eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis bei. Vielfalt und Inklusion sind für uns keine Trends, sondern fest verankert in unserer Unternehmenskultur. Daher freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen: unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität. Bitte beachte, dass wir diese Stelle ausschließlich als Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen Deines Studiums anbieten. Du hast fachliche Fragen zum Job? Susanne Seiß (Fachabteilung) +49 981 54-3890

Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch. Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Internship / Stage Planning Operations (Supply Chain)
description:
As a Planning Operations Intern at JDE Peet's, you will join the Belux Operations team and contribute to the planning and execution of technical services for our B2B coffee machine customers. This internship will provide valuable insights into how we deliver exceptional service to our customers and create remarkable customer experiences. Your main responsibilities: Support the Planning (Dispatching) and Installation team with day-to-day operational tasks (approximately 60% of your time), including: Creating service calls in the system based on customer requests Coordinating with field technicians regarding their schedules and assignments Assisting the logistics team with daily monitoring and follow-up of operational routines Supporting cross-functional initiatives to resolve operational issues Coordinating the planning and scheduling of installations and project rollouts Processing orders from draft to pending status Contribute to process improvement initiatives (approximately 40% of your time) by: Identifying opportunities for improvement within your function and across operations Developing and proposing enhancement recommendations based on operational insights Participate in field visits with the technical team to gain firsthand understanding of customer needs and business operations This is a hands-on, practical internship focused on gaining real work experience rather than conducting research.

You are an enthusiastic student with a matching educational business background, and preferably a supply chain or operations passionate. Your internship is a mandatory aspect of your studies. You are a team player with strong communication & analytical skills You work pro-actively, take ownership of your own projects and deadlines, and are result driven You can have basic understanding/ability to speak in either Dutch or French and be fluent in English You’re available for at least 5 to 6 months starting from February 2027 Your internship is a mandatory part of your studies

title: Procurement Intern
description:
Job Description

What's on the menu

We have an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic Bachelor or Master student who is interested in making a difference in Procurement at Kraft Heinz. 

In Kraft Heinz you’ll be the owner of your ideas and of your career. We offer an upbeat and innovative work environment. Besides from your daily tasks, you are motivated to speak up and generate new insights. We appreciate a new perspective! 

Our team consists of creative problem solvers, and high performers worldwide. We stand committed to responsible, sustainable practices that extend to every facet of our business, our consumers, and our communities. Every day, we redefine the food industry with daring thinking and outstanding results. If you share our passion – and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen – there’s only one thing to do: Join our table and let’s make life delicious! 

Our Culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration 

We're not afraid to think differently! Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people– from entry-level intern to senior leader – to own their work. We share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success – which we apply to every situation, every day. 

As part of our team, we want to help you grow and achieve. You are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work every day, to lead with humility, and drive outstanding performance at every level. You’re given opportunities to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’re supported by passionate teammates along the way, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress. 

The Positions 

Every internship at Kraft Heinz Netherlands offers outstanding opportunities to develop new knowledge and skills, gain real business experience, get exposure to senior leadership, and attend tailored trainings. As an intern you will take ownership of projects and work closely with the business on day-to-day challenges. 

You will have the opportunity to explore the day-to-day procurement functions and participate in a variety of projects in one of the largest food companies worldwide. Most meaningfully, you will get to showcase your initiatives and receive exposure from the Management team. 

The following procurement internship positions are available: 

  • Procurement Indirect: Supporting projects in Indirect procurement particularly for marketing, sales, IT, and sea freight. Support in sourcing, contracting; and ad hoc projects. 

In case you have a preference, please let us know and this will be respected as much as possible 

Tasks throughout the various roles can include: 

  • Market analysis by portfolio 
  • Assist buyer financial reports 
  • Contact suppliers and support buyer negotiations 
  • Assist category leads and buyers in day-to-day tasks at hand e.g. contract management, invoice resolution, supplier queries, purchase order approvals

title: Internship: Building the tax department of the future, automated indirect tax & global VAT analytics
description: Job Title Internship: Building the tax department of the future, automated indirect tax & global VAT analytics Job Description Assignment type : Internship Start date : February 2027 Assignment duration : 6 months Location : Veghel Education level : Bachelor / Master Desired study : Tax law, fiscal economics, finance Language : Dutch / English Description of assignment Are you eager to dive into the intersection of international indirect tax, supply chain operations, and tax technology? At our headquarters in Veghel, Vanderlande is looking for a motivated student to support the automation and documentation of our EMEA Indirect Tax (compliance) positions. In this hands-on role, you will learn how Vanderlande manages its EMEA indirect tax positions and connected compliance obligations using our Tax Control Framework and the Risk, Control, Monitoring (RiCoMo) matrix. You will support the rollout of the global indirect tax country file program by assessing risks, identifying opportunities, and contributing to transaction mappings per project/compliance country. These country files directly feed into our ERP blueprint and drive compliance automation. Furthermore, you will actively participate in our automation program—utilizing low-code data tools like Alteryx—to reduce manual workload and error sensitivity in our EMEA Shared Service Center. Department description You will join Vanderlande’s Group Tax department in Veghel, operating at the center of our global business activities. Our team works in close collaboration with international finance teams, supply chain managers, legal advisors, and external tax experts across multiple jurisdictions. We offer a young, ambitious, and internationally oriented work environment with professionals experienced in global tax control frameworks. Here, you will actively participate in real-world tax technology projects with high business visibility. Tasks/responsibilities Support the rollout of the global indirect tax country file program across relevant EMEA project and compliance countries Support the preparation and maintenance of the indirect tax ERP blueprint, including transaction mapping Support the Vanderlande indirect tax compliance automation program to optimize workflows and decrease manual administrative tasks Assist in assessing indirect tax risks and identifying optimization opportunities within the RiCoMo matrix framework Your profile Strong interest in indirect tax (VAT) and the digital automation of tax compliance processes Advanced working proficiency with Excel and eagerness to learn/apply tax software automation tools Prior experience with data/tax tooling (such as Alteryx) is a plus, but not required Analytical mindset capable of structuring complex transactional information into clear, practical processes Good communication skills in English; proficiency in Dutch is helpful but not required What we offer A monthly internship allowance (based on a 40-hour work week): Bachelor: €500 per month Master: €550 per month Full commuting allowance, including public transport, depending on whether you have access to free public transport or not On-site health center with gym Active employee communities and initiatives Excellent company restaurant and barista coffee bar Contact Do you recognize yourself in this challenging profile? Our Culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration

Every internship at Kraft Heinz Netherlands offers unique learning opportunities to develop new knowledge and skills, gain real business experience, get exposure to senior leadership and attend personalized trainings.   • Team player: Self-motivated, flexible and a team player who likes to work with people within a multicultural environment.
  • Eagerness to learn about Supply Chain & Logistics in an international, fast-moving environment.

Note: The recruitment process can take 4/6 weeks in total.
Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

What we offer you 

Program start date: January 2027.

title: Operations Finance Intern
description:
Job Description

What’s on the menu


We have an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic Bachelor or Master student who is interested in making a difference in Finance at Kraft Heinz!

Build a strong understanding of how financial planning, reporting and analysis support business decisions at Kraft Heinz. As part of the Operations Finance team, you will help transform financial data into actionable insights that support the performance of some of the world's most iconic food brands.

Kraft Heinz offers a fast-moving and collaborative environment in which ownership, curiosity and practical problem-solving are valued. The internship is designed to combine hands-on experience with learning: you will contribute to current business priorities, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and become part of the wider intern community.

If you share our passion and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen, there's only one thing to do: Join our table and let's make life delicious!

 

The position 


You will support the Operations Finance team within the Emerging Markets business and contribute to financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and decision support activities.

Working closely with Finance colleagues as well as Sales, Marketing, Category and Supply Chain teams, you will help ensure that business performance is accurately tracked and translated into clear insights. The role offers broad exposure to core finance processes, from month-end reporting and forecasting cycles to budget management and performance analysis.

As an intern at Kraft Heinz, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities from the start. Alongside your day-to-day work, you will have opportunities to develop your analytical and business partnering skills, learn how different functions work together and build relationships across an international organization. You will receive support from experienced colleagues while being encouraged to take ownership of projects and deliverables.

 

What you’ll do


  • Support weekly and monthly financial reporting routines, including performance tracking and business reviews
  • Assist with month-end closing activities and help ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial data
  • Contribute to forecasting, budgeting and annual operating planning processes
  • Prepare financial reports, dashboards and management presentations
  • Analyze business performance, identify key variances, trends and risks, and support the development of recommendations
  • Monitor volume, sales and profitability performance against forecasts, budgets and prior-year results
  • Support marketing and commercial spend tracking, budget management and financial controls
  • Maintain and improve master data quality and support data validation activities
  • Assist with purchase order and invoice management processes
  • Support ad hoc analyses, process improvement initiatives and automation projects

 

Job requirements 


  • Current Bachelor’s or Master’s enrolment at a European university (preferably in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business) for at least 50% of the internship period  (for EU citizens) or at a Dutch university for the entire duration of the internship (for non-EU citizens)
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel 
  • Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or SAP is a plus. 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills, Dutch is an advantage

NOTE: EU working rights are required (Either you have EU Citizenship, or you are studying in the Netherlands).

 

Location(s)

Amsterdam


 


Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.

description:
Werkstudierendenstelle Werkstudierende Logistik (m/w/d)

title: Intern Compliance HR Operations
description: Work Flexibility: Hybrid We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Compliance Intern for our HR Operations team . You will support the team with compliance, audit, internal controls, documentation review and preparation and process improvement activities across EMEA. Interest in HR Operations, including Payroll and Workforce Management, and how processes and controls support the business. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Basic skills in data analysis, process mapping, and documentation Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and tools Netherlands Pay Ranges: Intern allowance €1000 per month If you’d like to learn more about the compensation associated with this opportunity, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process. title: HR & People Operations Intern
description:
We are Skytree Skytree enables a transition to a world with cleaner Air for everyone. We do this by developing and deploying smart technology that captures atmospheric carbon dioxide, enabling its use or storage to combat climate change and aid society and businesses around the world. Born out of the European Space Agency (ESA), we are a global team of highly talented scientists, engineers and business professionals, supported by an experienced management team. Our working culture is based on a dynamic and smart approach to business with an open and understanding attitude to others and a desire to expand the boundaries of what is possible. As we enter a new phase of growth, we are looking for an HR & People Operations Intern within our dynamic People & Places team to learn, grow, and go on this journey with us. Your role As an HR & People Operations Intern, you will become an integral part of the People & Places team across a wide range of activities, gaining hands-on experience in a fast-paced, mission-driven tech environment. This internship is ideal for someone curious about how HR operates within a scaling startup, covering everything from recruitment to People administration and office operations. You’ll work closely with the team and contribute to creating a smooth and engaging employee journey. Important Notes: This practical internship provides hands-on and immersive experience into the world of work in HR. Internship duration is 6-9 months, on full-time basis (40 hours /week). The start date is as soon as possible. This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Please ensure that you meet the legal requirements to undertake an internship in The Netherlands. You must be based in The Netherlands, ideally near Amsterdam. We offer a monthly internship allowance, lunch allowance, and transportation allowance. However, accommodation is not provided. Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll be learning and supporting HR Operations & Administration Develop an understanding of core HR Operations by supporting employee data management, onboarding/offboarding processes, and critical administrative tasks within the People team. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Learn how to manage and own the recruitment process from end to end (initial proposals up until hiring stage). Office & Workplace Management Build practical experience in office operations by supporting day-to-day workplace needs, vendor coordination, and internal event organization. HR Tools & Process Improvement Gain exposure to HR systems (HRIS, ATS) and explore opportunities to improve processes, including the use of automation and AI tools. You definitely won’t be bored here, but we want to be intentional about where your energy and ambitions lie. Our goal is to shape an internship that accelerates your learning curve, aligns with your aspirations, and helps you grow into the kind of People Professional you want to become. That means focusing not only on the content and hands-on experience, but also on developing your natural strengths and the skills you’re excited to build for the future.

What we’re looking for Recently graduated or currently pursuing (as long as your schedule allows 32-40 hour/week) Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. Most importantly, you’re eager to work for and with people. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn in a dynamic environment. Comfortable handling administrative tasks while staying curious about the bigger picture. Strong communication skills in English. Dutch is preferred! High level of self-awareness. No one is perfect, but you bring a reflective understanding of your strengths, natural pitfalls and how to cope with these. Interest in HR, people topics, and startup environments. Bonus points if you’ve had exposure to HR tools, enjoy working with data, and have a curiosity (or even better, a passion) for automation & AI. if you believe in working smarter, not harder, thrive on continuous improvement, and naturally look for ways to optimize and improve whatever can be optimized, you’ll fit right in. You are already based in the Netherlands, within commuting distance to Amsterdam. Lastly, you’re intrinsically driven to get the most out of this internship! It probably will not fit if you’re applying because you have to. It will fly if you’re applying because you eagerly want to! What you can expect Apart from working with great colleagues, you can also expect: A unique start-up environment offering organic professional and personal growth at one of the most innovative cleantech companies in Amsterdam! A diverse (30+ nationalities) and fun team to work with. title: Tourism & Operations Internship
description:
ABOUT US

Indie Campers, the go-to campervan Marketplace, is on a mission of making road trips available to everyone. Thanks to its digital approach and customer-centric orientation, Indie Campers has developed a strong booking experience and high-quality road trips at affordable prices.

With over two million nights rented through our travel platform, we have welcomed hundreds of thousands of travelers from all over the world. Operating across 100+ locations in Europe, North America, and Oceania, we offer a comprehensive and expanding array of road trip possibilities: short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the possibility of buying one of our vehicles available for sale.

Rooted in a deep technological focus, our challenges are both exciting and demanding and require top talent and motivation to be successfully pursued. We are growing our team and looking for those interested in pursuing this dream with us and joining an ever-developing journey.

THE ROLE

We're on the lookout for passionate students or recent graduates who want to dive into the exciting world of RV and campervan rentals and gain hands-on tourism experience at our depot, located in Alte Bottroper Str. 72, 45356 Essen, Germany.

As our Tourism & Operations Intern, you'll be the friendly face of our brand - welcoming guests, setting them up for road trips of a lifetime, and ensuring their journey ends just as wonderfully as it began. If you thrive on meeting new people, love a challenge, and enjoy the buzz of a fast-paced environment, your next adventure starts here!

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON?

Front-office activities:

  • Customer service and sales: Take care of check-ins and check-outs, register guests, process payments, explain campervan functionalities, terms and conditions, upsell road trip extras.

Back-office activities:

  • Operations handling: Align the reservations with the available campervans, verify and prepare campers and road trip extras and kits.
  • Quality control: Maintain the campervans in top condition, identify and act on possible maintenance or repair needs.
  • Support activities: Support the team in monitoring the existing stock, coordinating the fleet of campervans, troubleshooting operational issues.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • You are a student or recent graduate in Hospitality, Tourism, International Studies, Business Administration or a related field looking for an internship;
  • You are fluent in English, have a work permit (if applicable), and a valid driver's licence (for both manual and automatic vehicles);
  • You like international environments and meeting new cultures;
  • You possess a natural talent for connecting with people and have a strong customer service orientation;
  • You have a problem-solving mindset, thriving to create solutions and feeling comfortable with getting your hands dirty.

THE INDIE COMMITMENT

  • All internships are compensated;
  • Online and on-the-job training to develop relevant skills to your growth: guest relations, customer service, problem-solving, communication, team spirit, organization, time management, fleet coordination, supplies management and logistics;
  • International opportunities and possibility of integration in Indie Campers after the internship.

Are you ready to Go Indie?

title: Mechanical Design Engineering Internship, Battery Engineering, Tesla Engineering Germany (m/f/d)
description:
### What to Expect

Duration: min. 6 months Time type: Full TimeStart date: As soon as possibleTesla is seeking highly motivated engineering students who thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to apply mechanical concepts to real world projects. Our team drives collaboration with many engineering groups - team players only. Tesla moves quickly, so being self-motivated and disciplined is critical. You must be passionate, but direction changes quickly, so you must also be resilient. As an intern you will work directly with full-time engineers to design, prototype, test and launch new parts and processes to improve our batteries. Our projects include advanced cooling systems, cell interfaces and high voltage distribution. Every day we push the boundaries of what is possible for energy storage in our vehicles, demanding extreme attention to details and the highest standard of performance, quality and manufacturability.

### What You’ll Do

* Design new battery components that improve product metrics (performance, cost, mass)
* Own basic testing and analysis; support advanced testing and analysis
* Develop various test jigs and fixtures to validate battery components
* Design 3D/2D models of complex parts and assemblies
* Root cause test failures and process/manufacturing issues
* Collaborate with other teams inside Tesla (manufacturing, testing, NPI, supply chain, etc.)
* Create sources of truth to reference important findings

### What You’ll Bring

* Currently working towards a BS, MS, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering program such as Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field
* Strong knowledge of engineering fundamentals, such as mechanics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, material properties and basic electronics
* Demonstrated hands-on abilities (e.g. machine shop skills, technical hobbies/academic projects, etc.) - Experience with student Formula Vehicle, Solar Car, etc. is a plus
* Proficiency in CAD modeling. CATIA V5/V6 and 3DX experience is a plus
* Strong knowledge of tolerance analysis, applying GD&T, finite element analysis (FEA), and basic thermal models
* Detail-oriented personality with top-tier documentation and reporting skills
* Fluency in English, German is a plus

description:
ABOUT US

Indie Campers, the go-to campervan Marketplace, is on a mission of making road trips available to everyone. Thanks to its digital approach and customer-centric orientation, Indie Campers has developed a strong booking experience and high-quality road trips at affordable prices. 

With over one million nights rented through our travel platform, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travelers from 169 countries. We offer a comprehensive and expanding array of road trip possibilities: short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the possibility of buying one of our vehicles available for sale.

Rooted in a deep technological focus, our challenges are both exciting and demanding and require top talent and motivation to be successfully pursued. We are growing our team and looking for those interested in pursuing this dream with us and joining an ever-developing journey.

 

THE ROLE

We’re on the lookout for passionate students or recent graduates who want to dive into the exciting world of RV and campervan rentals and gain hands-on tourism experience at our Brussels Depot located in Waversebaan 24c, 1982 Zemst, Belgium.

As our Tourism & Operations Intern, you’ll be the friendly face of our brand - welcoming guests, setting them up for road trips of a lifetime, and ensuring their journey ends just as wonderfully as it began. If you thrive on meeting new people, love a challenge, and enjoy the buzz of a fast-paced environment, your next adventure starts here!

 

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON?

Front-office activities:

  • Customer service and sales: Take care of check-ins and check-outs, register guests, process payments, explain campervan functionalities, terms and conditions, upsell road trip extras.

Back-office activities:

  • Operations handling: Align the reservations with the available campervans, verify and prepare campers and road trip extras and kits.
  • Quality control: Maintain the campervans in top condition, identify and act on possible maintenance or repair needs.

Deine Stärken: Teamfähigkeit, Kontaktstärke, Serviceorientierung und eine Hands-On-Mentalität zeichnen Dich aus. Außerdem besitzt Du Organisationstalent und arbeitest sorgfältig und selbständig. Die Praktikumsstellen sind fortlaufend für mindestens 3 Monate zu besetzen. Im Anschluss an das Praktikum ist eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit gegebenenfalls möglich.

title: Praktikum Organisations- und Prozessberatung (w/m/d)
description: Du willst mit Deinem Engagement die Zukunft moderner Unternehmensorganisationen mitgestalten? Unterstütze im Bereich Organisations- und Prozessberatung unser Team dabei, Unternehmensprozesse in Finance, IT und Supply Chain nachhaltig zu optimieren, mit dem Fokus auf Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und smarteren Arbeitsweisen. Dein Beitrag zählt: Du hilfst, Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und innovativer zu machen und wirkst so an echten Veränderungsprojekten mit. Sammle wertvolle Praxiserfahrung und bringe Deine Stärken aktiv ein. Dein Praktikum findet mit einer Länge von mindestens 3 bis höchstens 6 Monaten statt.

title: School Internship 2027 Commercial/IT (m/w/d)
description: Become part of an internationally successful industrial company and benefit from a strong community with over 8,800 colleagues worldwide. As a leading supplier of industrial machine needles, precision parts, fine tools as well as systems and services for the production and joining of textile surfaces, Groz-Beckert combines creativity with a passion for textiles. Find your opportunity to join us and be infected by the fascination! At Groz-Beckert you can get to know the exciting world of work even before you start your training or studies! In the commercial area, you will get to know the commercial side of the complex value-added process - for example through assignments in the areas of purchasing, logistics, marketing and sales. During your time in the various departments, you will also have the opportunity to get to know the "Next Generation" training company in practice. Here you will experience first-hand what it means to run a company. From ordering and receiving goods to shipping and invoicing, everything has to be done carefully. There is never a dull moment with such a wide range of tasks. A student internship usually lasts one week. Depending on your area of interest, you will be assigned to different departments where you will be able to try out some of the activities typical of the profession. For a voluntary internship, you must be at least 15 years old. If you are completing your internship as part of a school program (mandatory internship), the minimum age is 13. In this case, please also upload a confirmation from your school. We look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Please send them to us via our career portal. If you have any questions, please call 07431-10 3020.

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) Vertriebsinnendienst
description: Das erwartet Sie Beratung: Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehört die proaktive Beratung unserer Industriekunden telefonisch, per Mail oder teilweise auch persönlich. Mit Ihrem Fachwissen zu unserem breiten Produktsortiment bieten Sie unseren Kunden optimale Lösungen für deren Versorgung mit C-Teilen. So gestalten Sie eine erfolgreiche Entwicklung der gemeinsamen Partnerschaft mit unseren Kunden für die Zukunft. Auftragsmanagement: Sie verantworten und sichern die Koordination und Einsteuerung unserer Kundenaufträge – von der Kalkulation des Verkaufspreises, über die Erstellung des Angebotes bis hin zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Hierbei bewegen Sie sich in unserer Würth-eigenen Systemlandschaft, um die Versorgung unserer Kunden optimal zu gestalten. Teamwork: Sie unterstützen den Außendienst und arbeiten darüber hinaus sehr eng mit den unterschiedlichen Abteilungen (bspw. Einkauf und Technik) der Würth Industrie Service in Bad Mergentheim zusammen. Controlling: Mittels CRM & ERP-System dokumentieren und verfolgen Sie die Verkaufschancen, um so Potentiale bei unseren Kunden zu identifizieren. Internationalität: Sie betreuen zusammen in Ihrem Team einen internationalen Großkunden aus dem Bereich der Baumaschinen Branche. Hierbei arbeiten Sie mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen intern sowie auch aus Schwestergesellschaften zusammen. Das bringen Sie mit Fachkompetenz: Mit einer abgeschlossenen kaufmännischen Ausbildung oder Studium mit Bezug zum Aufgabengebiet sind Sie genau richtig! Erfahrung: Ganz gleich, ob Sie bereits jahrelange Erfahrung im Vertriebsumfeld mitbringen oder möglicherweise auch erst direkt nach Ihrer Ausbildung oder Ihrem Studium stehen: Bei uns steht die Motivation und die Freude am Vertrieb im Vordergrund. Ihre Stärken: Sie verfügen über eine sehr gute Kommunikationskompetenz, zeichnen sich durch eine sorgfältige sowie eigenständige Arbeitsweise aus und übernehmen gerne Verantwortung. Ebenfalls haben Sie Freude daran, sich in neue Sachverhalte hineinzudenken und daraus resultierend Lösungsansätze mit den verschiedenen Fachabteilungen im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Das bieten wir Ihnen Flexibilität: Privatleben und Job im Gleichgewicht? Das schaffen wir mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. Für soziales Engagement können Sie sich zwei Tage pro Jahr bezahlt freistellen lassen. On top haben Sie 30 Tage Urlaub. Weiterbildung: Wir tun alles dafür, dass Sie sich individuell entwickeln und entfalten können – das reicht von einer fundierten Einarbeitung über zielgerichtete, interne und externe Schulungsreihen sowie eine Auswahl aus über 300 E-Learnings, die ein flexibles Lernen direkt am Arbeitsplatz ermöglichen. Unternehmenskultur: Gegenseitige Hilfsbereitschaft, das herzliche und respektvolle Miteinander sowie das gemeinsame Feiern bei Teamessen, Teamausflügen, Betriebsfeiern und vieles mehr machen uns aus! Benefits: Urlaubs-/Weihnachtsgeld, Kindergartenzuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ein umfangreiches Gesundheitsmanagement sowie interessante Bonusprogramme zu vergünstigten Konditionen (z. B. im Bereich Reisen, Wohnen, Mode) unterstreichen, dass bei uns der Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht.

title: Internship
description:
Internship Eligibility Please note that we can only offer internships to students who are currently enrolled at a university or other recognized higher-education institution for the full duration of the internship. Your educational institution must be able to provide and sign an official internship/learning agreement between you, the institution, and SkyGeo. ————— About SkyGeo SkyGeo is a leading provider of satellite radar interferometry (InSAR) solutions. Our strength is not only producing millimeter-level deformation estimates, but diagnosing what the movements mean in the context of an asset, an operation, and the decisions teams need to make. We work with customers to incorporate site context and monitoring objectives, so the output is not just a sea of data. This approach reduces the risk of misinterpretation and helps organizations manage assets for the long term. The Internship We are continuously looking for motivated and curious students to join our Data Analytics team as interns. As an intern at SkyGeo, you will work on real-world applications of InSAR, supporting projects in fields such as: Infrastructure monitoring (railways, dikes, pipelines, buildings, bridges, tunnels, etc.) Energy assets (oil & gas, offshore wind, CO₂ storage/CCS, pipelines and related infrastructure) Mining operations (subsidence, slope stability, tailings facilities, asset monitoring) You will gain hands-on experience in processing and interpreting satellite data, developing innovative methodologies, and applying geospatial analysis to solve complex challenges.

Who we are looking for We welcome students with a background in: Geoscience, Geodesy, Remote Sensing, Civil Engineering, or related fields Strong analytical and quantitative skills Affinity with GIS, remote sensing, and programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, R) Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn What we offer An opportunity to work with cutting-edge satellite data and technology Guidance and mentorship from experienced InSAR specialists A dynamic and international team environment Flexible internship periods (to fit study requirements) Possibility to link the internship to thesis research How to Apply We have four internship places available in 2027, with start dates spread throughout the year. Internships typically last 5 to 6 months. We’ll post regular updates on availability on our website. If you are interested, we are happy to receive your CV and a short motivation letter (including your preferred internship period). Join SkyGeo and contribute to understanding and monitoring our changing world – from space...

title: Praktikum Trade Marketing & Category Management
description: Praktikum Trade Marketing & Category Management Ort : Aretsried | Bereich : Marketing | Einstiegslevel: Studenten | Job-ID: 102631 Arbeiten bei der Unternehmensgruppe Theo Müller bedeutet, Teil eines regional verwurzelten Familienunternehmens und international wachsenden Konzerns im Bereich Food und Logistics zu sein. Mit bekannten Marken in den Geschäftsbereichen Molkerei, Fisch & Feinkost, Saucen und Dressings, einem eigenen Verpackungsunternehmen, einem Transport- und Logistikunternehmen und einem eigenen Kraftwerk steht die Unternehmensgruppe für Vielfalt, Unabhängigkeit und Sicherheit. Die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Unternehmensgruppe teilen eine gemeinsame Vision: Geschmack in das Leben der Menschen zu bringen. Begleite uns auf dieser Reise und sichere Dir einen Job mit Zukunftsperspektive. Wir suchen Dich ab sofort in Aretsried für das Praktikum Trade Marketing & Category Management. Deine Rolle Du wirkst bei der Planung, Steuerung und Auswertung national Vermarktungsmaßnahmen am Ponit of Sale aktiv mit. Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst Du Verkaufs- und Präsentationsmaterialien sowie below-the-line Werbematerial Bei kundenindividuellen Projekten unterstützt Du das Team und übernimmst sogar eigenständig ein kleines Projekt Du analysierst Handels- und Haushaltspaneldaten sowie Shopper Insights. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Agenturen ermöglicht Dir vielseitige Einblicke in das Marketing. Dein Profil Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Wichtig ist Dir, das erlernte theoretische Wissen in einem sechsmonatigen Praktikum oder alternativ in einer Werkstudententätigkeit „on the job“ zu vertiefen. Idealerweise konntest Du schon erste praktische Erfahrungen in der FMCG-Branche sammeln. Ein sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Word, Excel und PowerPoint zeichnet Dich aus. Du bist ein Teamplayer, hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst sowohl kreative als auch analytische Fähigkeiten mit. Viel mehr Extras als Du denkst Mentoring: Karrieremöglichkeiten sind bei uns fest verankert und wir unterstützen Dich dabei, durch unsere fachliche und persönliche Begleitung, Deine individuellen Ziele zu erreichen. Work-Life-Balance: Wir bieten Azubis 30 Tage und Studierenden sowie Praktikanten bis zu 20 Tage Erholungsurlaub, sowie in einigen Bereichen flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit an. Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen: Unsere Betriebsrestaurants stellen ein vergünstigtes und gesundes Essensangebot bereit. Getränke wie Kaffee oder Wasser sowie Produktkühlschränke stehen kostenfrei zur Verfügung. Extra Benefits: Wir haben mit über 600 Top-Marken besondere Einkaufskonditionen verhandelt. Zusätzlich bieten wir ein Firmen-Fitnessprogramm von Hansefit und einen Zuschuss zu den Fahrtkosten an. Mitarbeiterempfehlung: Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Eine Empfehlung wird bei uns mit bis zu 1.500 € brutto belohnt. Überrascht, dass wir viel mehr sind? Erfahre noch mehr über uns! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns Deine Bewerbung einfach über unser Job-Portal. Es sind Fragen offen geblieben? Rebecca Reitschuster beantwortet Deine Fragen gerne per Mail ( R.Reitschuster@muellergroup.com ). Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung. Wir beschränken uns im Text auf die männlichen Bezeichnungen, um den Lesefluss zu erleichtern.

title: B2B Marketing Internship
description:
Do you want to contribute to a more sustainable world? Are you excited to help shape the future of battery technology and consequently the future of consumer electronics and mobility? Can you not wait to dive into a VC-backed deep tech scale-up with the ambition to change the world? At LeydenJar Technologies , we’re on a mission to redefine the future of energy storage. Our goal is to become the world’s innovation leader in advanced battery anodes, empowering the next generation of batteries that drive progress. Why does this matter? Because the world needs higher energy density batteries not just for better consumer electronics, but for electric vehicles, e-flight, and beyond. While the battery industry typically advances by only 3% per year, our breakthrough pure silicon anode technology delivers an improvement of up to 70% is a true game changer. Often called the “holy grail” of the battery industry, our technology unlocks new possibilities for electrification, sustainability, and resilience in global supply chains. What we do: We produce pure silicon anode rolls that fit seamlessly into existing battery cell manufacturing lines, enabling customers to make a quantum leap in performance or create entirely new product categories. Our initial focus is on consumer electronics, with automotive applications already in development. By leveraging semiconductor thin-film technology (plasma deposition) and scaling it to battery anodes, we’ve overcome the long-standing challenges of silicon in batteries, delivering durability and efficiency at scale. To meet global demand, we’re scaling up: PlantOne in Eindhoven opens in 2026 , producing anode rolls and validating our roll-to-roll production tools. PlantTwo , our large-scale production facility, will follow, establishing LeydenJar as a key player in the global battery market. This is an enormous opportunity and an ambitious journey. It requires bold, creative, and diverse minds who share our passion for innovation and sustainability. At LeydenJar, we value different perspectives, inclusive collaboration, and gender equality because we know that diversity fuels breakthrough ideas. We are looking for an enthusiastic Marketing Intern to join our fast-paced B2B Commercial Team . In this role, you will act as a key on-the-ground contributor in the Netherlands, supporting social media channels, event/trade show logistics, and general marketing initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Marketing (based in the US) and work closely on-site with local business developers, engineers, and technical teams in Europe. Location: On-site in Leiden, Netherlands (with occasional travel/visits to PlantOne in Eindhoven). You will be responsible for: Social Media & Digital Content Assist in drafting, scheduling, and publishing content across corporate social media channels (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube). Monitor social media engagement, track channel analytics, and support audience growth strategies. Capture on-site photos, short video clips, and updates from the Leiden and Eindhoven facilities for promotional use. Event & Trade Show Logistics Support the execution and preparation for major B2B industry trade shows, conferences, and exhibitions. Assist with event logistics, booth collateral shipping/setup, promotional merchandise management, and vendor coordination. Help compile post-event lead data and competitor summaries from industry gatherings. Market Research & General Marketing Support Conduct B2B market research and competitive benchmarking across the battery and energy storage sectors. Support the creation of marketing collateral, presentation decks, newsletters, and press distribution materials. Perform additional marketing and administrative coordination tasks as needed to support global marketing operations. Analyze data to provide insights for product development and marketing strategies. If necessary, we may require you to perform activities normally undertaken by others or to take on additional activities.

About You: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or related field Excellent written and spoken English communication skills (English is our working language) Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data Excellent written and verbal communication skills Familiarity with Microsoft Office suite Working knowledge of Adobe Create Suite and Google Analytics Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment You are eligible to complete your internship in the Netherlands Are you ready to take on the challenge as a B2B Product Marketing Intern? We are looking forward to your application! At LeydenJar we value diversity, and we provide equal opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, pregnancy/childbirth, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, etc. If there are two or more applicants of equal suitability for a certain position, LeydenJar can under circumstances decide to select applicants based on positive discrimination in full compliance with all relevant and applicable law.
